svg.title: nabaskar brahma
svg.desc: A four-scene loop. First a terminal session typing out test results. Then ShortCircuit's rate limiter, showing a stop-loss order taking a reserved lane past queued scanner traffic. Then Driftwatch reconciling Redis against a replayed event stream. Then the MCP gateway subtracting a declared capability set from observed syscalls to build a seccomp filter.

g.text: backend · distributed systems · the parts that fail quietly
89 order IDs recovered · payload nesting defect fixed
the reserved lane is why a stop-loss never queues behind scanner traffic

text.tspan: no divergence outside the settlement window
held for the version fence and a second confirm

g.text: the filter is what is left after subtracting the declaration from what the server actually did
84.6% detection at a measured 25-50% false positives · 87.5% containment · 503/503 identical
one event loop, five supervised tasks, ordered shutdown
a disagreement is not drift until the fence agrees
